# Twofold

> Twofold is a free, open source visual diff tool for macOS. It compares two text files or two images side by side, or two folders with a sidebar of changed files. It is a native AppKit app (no Electron, no web view), licensed under GPLv3, with no subscription, no account and no telemetry.

Key facts:

- Platform: macOS 26 or later, universal binary for Apple silicon and Intel.
- Price: free from GitHub. A Mac App Store version is planned at 4,99 € as a one-time purchase (same app, no subscription).
- License: GPLv3. Source code: https://github.com/veturi/twofold
- Download: https://github.com/veturi/twofold/releases/latest
- Website: https://twofoldapp.org/

## What it does

- File comparison with two layouts. Fluid: change blocks on each side are joined by curves through a centre ribbon, and both sides scroll so the current change stays aligned, with no filler lines. Blocks: matching lines sit on the same row and both panes scroll together.
- Word-level highlights inside changed lines, refined to characters when only part of a word changed.
- Folder comparison: walks two directory trees, pairs files by relative path, and streams changed, added and removed files into a sidebar while the comparison runs in parallel.
- Merging: copy any change from one side to the other (buttons on the change, ⌥⌘→ / ⌥⌘←), undo and redo, and save with ⌘S. Saving rewrites only the changed lines: encoding, byte order mark, each line's line ending and the presence of a final newline are kept. Nothing is written until you save, and the app asks before discarding unsaved changes.
- Syntax highlighting on top of the change colours, for 29 languages and formats: Swift, C, C++, Objective-C, Java, Kotlin, C#, Scala, Dart, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Ruby, Go, Rust, PHP, shell, SQL, Lua, HTML, XML, CSS, JSON, YAML, TOML, INI, Markdown, Makefile and Dockerfile. The language is picked from the file name or a `#!` line; ⌥⌘Y switches it off.
- Image comparison in three views: side by side, overlay (fade from one image to the other), and difference (every changed pixel highlighted, changed regions outlined, with a count of differing pixels). Zoom and pan are shared by both sides. Reads PNG, JPEG, HEIC, TIFF, GIF, WebP and other formats macOS can decode; images also open from a folder comparison.
- Unchanged runs fold away, soft wrapping, an overview strip of all changes, animated next/previous change navigation (⌘↓ / ⌘↑).
- Reloads automatically when either file changes on disk.
- Reads UTF-8, UTF-16 and Latin-1 text with LF, CRLF or CR line endings. A difference in line endings alone is not shown as a change.
- Light and dark themes.
- Command line tool `twofold a b`, and works as `git difftool`, including whole-tree comparisons with `git difftool --dir-diff`.
- Performance: diffs 100,000 lines in under 60 ms, scrolls at 120 Hz, compares 10,000 files per side in about a second.

## What it does not do (yet)

- No typing or free-form editing yet: you can copy whole changes across, not edit text. Editing in place is next on the roadmap.
- No three-way merge (planned, for use as `git mergetool`).
- No PDF or general binary diff. Binary files that are not images are detected and reported as identical or different, nothing more. Animated and multi-page images are compared by their first frame.
- macOS only. There is no Windows or Linux version.

## How it compares

- Kaleidoscope: also a native, polished Mac diff tool, with merging, image diff and three-way merge, but sold as a subscription. Twofold is free and open source, and copies changes between sides, but has no in-place editing or three-way merge yet. https://twofoldapp.org/kaleidoscope-alternative/
- Beyond Compare: a powerful cross-platform comparison suite with a paid license. Twofold is narrower in scope but native to macOS and free. https://twofoldapp.org/beyond-compare-alternative/
- FileMerge (opendiff): Apple's free diff tool bundled with Xcode; it merges, but its interface has not changed in years. https://twofoldapp.org/filemerge-alternative/
- Meld: a free, open source GTK diff and merge tool, primarily for Linux; Mac builds come from the community. https://twofoldapp.org/meld-for-mac/

## Install

- Download the zip from GitHub releases, unzip, and move Twofold.app to Applications. Release builds are not notarized yet, so macOS asks you to allow the first launch in System Settings → Privacy & Security.
- Or build from source: `git clone https://github.com/veturi/twofold.git && cd twofold && make start` (needs the Xcode Command Line Tools).
- Use as git difftool:

```
git config --global diff.tool twofold
git config --global difftool.twofold.cmd 'twofold --wait "$LOCAL" "$REMOTE"'
git config --global difftool.prompt false
```
